title: Shivam Business Tower
description: A premium commercial office tower designed with modern architecture, smart infrastructure, and sustainable construction practices.
details: Shivam Business Tower is a 22-story Grade-A commercial building featuring premium office spaces, retail outlets, smart security systems, and energy-efficient infrastructure. The project is designed to meet IGBC Green Building standards.

title: Green Valley Villas
description: A premium gated residential township featuring luxurious villas with modern amenities and landscaped surroundings.
details: Green Valley Villas is a residential township consisting of 60 luxury villas with spacious interiors, private gardens, clubhouse facilities, children's play area, and eco-friendly infrastructure.

title: Bharat IT Park
description: A world-class IT park designed for technology companies, startups, and innovation centers.
details: Bharat IT Park consists of four modern office buildings equipped with collaborative workspaces, data centers, conference halls, incubation labs, and sustainable building systems.

title: Kerala Backwater Resort
description: A luxury eco-resort inspired by Kerala's natural beauty, offering sustainable hospitality and premium experiences.
details: Kerala Backwater Resort features 140 luxury rooms, private cottages, Ayurvedic wellness center, restaurants, and renewable energy systems, providing a perfect blend of comfort and sustainability.
